observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a diesel engine valve cover reading 'DAF 24 VALVE' and a stamped plate reading 'DAF' with a number '1428063'.
Photo 0: Visible oil residue, dust, and corrosion on surrounding engine parts (fan, pulleys, hoses).
Photo 1 & 2: Wide shots of a yard with multiple stripped engines, gearboxes, and axle parts stacked together, covered partially by a tarp, sitting on bare ground outdoors.
No visible engine stand test rig, no fuel lines connected, no smoke/exhaust, no sound/video evidence of running.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'HEPH AUTOS' overlay the photos; these are platform/seller branding, not technical data.
Wiring harnesses on some engines appear disconnected or dangling, suggesting these are pulled units, not installed/running engines.
Engine surfaces show mixed dirt, oxidation, and some shine from recent wipe-down in photo 0, inconsistent with 'excellent condition' claim.

claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show oil grime, dust, and corrosion on the block and ancillaries, not a clean unit.

claims.claim: In excellent condition and ready for work
claims.evidence: No start-up video, compression test, or oil/coolant check shown; engine sits disassembled in an open yard with disconnected wiring.
No running sound, smoke, or load test clip provided in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run (compression, internal wear, seized parts)
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine running/idling with visible exhaust and stable idle
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts grade

risks.risk: Water or rust ingress from prolonged outdoor storage under tarp
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cylinder bores, intake manifold interior, and oil dipstick condition

risks.risk: Missing ancillary components (turbo, injectors, sensors, wiring loom) not visible or dangling disconnected
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos of the engine including turbo, injector pump, and wiring harness intact

risks.risk: Unknown exact DAF engine model/displacement affecting part compatibility and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate (not just valve cover branding)
risks.if_unproven: priced at base generic used DAF truck engine tier

risks.risk: Engine could be a mixed/salvaged assembly (parts swapped from different donor engines in the yard)
risks.proof: Photo showing single unit isolated from the pile, with matching serial numbers on block and head

proof_requests: Video of the engine actually running/idling with sound
Clear photo of the full engine ID/serial plate
Close-up of cylinder bores and oil dipstick for rust/wear check
Full-view photos of the engine isolated from the yard pile, showing all sides and attached ancillaries
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used DAF 24-valve trailer head engine from the valve cover marking, but no evidence of running condition or completeness is shown, and the claimed 'excellent condition' is contradicted by visible grime and outdoor storage, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, possibly incomplete used engine.
